summary: The Divine Seat of Underfoot is Brell Serilis’s sanctum, where stone, crystal, and magma converge into pure divine authority. Guardians, titans, and forgeborn protect the throne, while Brell’s resonance shapes the realm.
history: Forged from the first stone Brell ever touched.
Crystal roots and magma flows converge in harmony.
Stone guardians were created to protect the sanctum.
Mortals reached the Throne only during the Age of Turmoil.
The Throne Prime manifested as embodiment of Brell’s divine authority.
